ActionAutoApproval.description: Any matching requester ID or requester membership tag automatically approves an otherwise permitted action. Empty lists require manual approval. These selectors never grant permission.

ActionPolicyUpdate.description: Owner or an admin delegated action_policies.manage can configure a rule. Owner always bypasses permission and approval gates. Authorized approvers perform their own permitted actions directly.

version.description: Zero is an unmodified default. Supply this version in If-Match when configuring.

ActionApproval.description: Approval binds the exact method, path, body, version, request key, session and application scope. Retry the original mutation after approval. Policy changes invalidate earlier approvals. Requests expire after twelve hours.

supported_api_versions.description: Server-supported API majors in descending preference order.

VerificationCode.description: Six-digit code with a ten-minute expiry; ten failed verifications trigger a 60-second reusable-challenge cooldown.

CarbonId.description: New immutable Carbon ID; zero is not admitted.

ExistingCarbonId.description: Existing Carbon lookup/projection, including immutable legacy IDs containing zero.

ApplicationHandle.description: Local handle of 1-80 lowercase ASCII characters, starting with a letter and containing only letters, digits, underscores or hyphens. Supplied at creation; the public ID is the same bare handle.

AppId.description: Globally unique bare Application handle. Owning org_id is supplied separately.

SiliconHandle.description: Client-supplied handle component; the public Silicon ID is `si:{handle}`; owning org_id is separate.

TimeZoneId.description: Exact identifier that must resolve in the IANA Time Zone Database, such as UTC or Asia/Kolkata.

local_otp.description: Present only when the explicitly configured local-development provider exposes the generated code.

expires_in.description: Present only when a new verification code was sent.

local_otp.description: Present only when the explicitly configured local-development provider exposes the generated code.

StepUpAction.description: Closed privileged-action catalog. account.session_revoke binds resource_id to the target session UUID; account.sessions_revoke_all binds it to the current immutable Carbon ID. The Silicon-webhook redirect action binds it to the target canonical Silicon membership ID. The Application client-secret rotation, webhook-secret rotation and webhook approval actions bind it to the canonical Application ID. Every action requires one non-null resource_id.

access_token.description: Carbon access tokens use cat_; Silicon access tokens use sat_.

TokenIntrospection.description: Live token state. An active access token also returns authorization, a synchronous bootstrap/resynchronization snapshot. No directory mutation or webhook delivery is required. An organization-bound token returns the one organization it is bound to in authorization. An unscoped token reaches only explicitly selected organizations with active membership: send X-Org-ID to select one of them and read authorization, or send no header and read authorizations, which lists one snapshot per organization and is empty when the subject holds no membership anywhere. Exactly one of the two fields is ever present. Refresh tokens carry no organization authorization.

ApplicationAuthorization.description: Current active membership bound to the authenticated token or verified proof, audience, organization, principal and testing plane. Use on first login and cache misses; webhook snapshots are asynchronous updates, not prerequisites for initial access. org_role requires roles.read and tags requires memberships.read. Null means undisclosed, not member or empty tags. OBO disclosure uses the intersection of the parent token scopes and recipient application's currently approved scopes. The binding authorizes no action outside the verified proof's endpoint/request. Do not reuse it for a different principal, membership, epoch, audience, organization, environment or effective scope set. Never fill undisclosed fields from a broader cached token. Introspect current bearer tokens again before relying on cached authority; a consumed OBO proof is single-use.

public_id.description: Public actor identifier, or null when directory access does not permit resolving it. The event remains visible to authorized history readers.

scope_version.description: Version of the consent view the user reviewed.

approved_scopes.description: Explicitly approved full effective scope set; external entries use obo:{app_id}:{endpoint_id}.

org_ids.description: Explicit user selection for this app; existing grants are preserved. Empty is allowed only for a Carbon approving an active organizations.create or organizations.join scope.

applications.description: Unique app IDs, each with its own organization selection.

expires_at.description: Absolute token expiry; unchanged by an idempotent replay.

scope_version.description: Version of the consent view the user reviewed.

approved_scopes.description: Explicitly approved full effective scope set; external entries use obo:{app_id}:{endpoint_id}.

org_ids.description: User-selected active organizations. Adds to this application's existing grants on the same parent IAM session; never includes future memberships automatically. Only a direct IAM bearer may submit this selection.

allow_empty_organization_selection.description: Whether this Carbon may continue without selecting organizations using an approved organizations.create or organizations.join permission. Empty selection adds no organization grants.

request_id.description: IAM login status identifier; never an application credential.

slt.description: IAM-issued one-time code, or an existing Carbon/Silicon ID in a verified testing environment.

Membership.description: Membership IDs use carbon_id[org_id] or the full silicon_id[org_id], for example saket[tos] or helper:tos[tos].

display_name.description: Present when profile reads are authorized.

default_trust.description: Carbon-wide advisory trust baseline; null for Silicon memberships.
Carbon-only advisory trust baseline; requires trust.manage.

DirectoryMember.description: Sparse organization-directory projection. Omitted fields were not requested. trust is null when no Carbon-to-Silicon or Silicon-to-Carbon/Silicon orientation exists, including Carbon-to-Carbon.

id.description: Public Carbon ID or global Silicon ID.

tag_trust_overrides.description: At most one override per active organization tag.

silicon_trust_overrides.description: At most one override per active Silicon membership.

redirect_app_id.description: Canonical organization-qualified Application id when the invitation should continue into an Application login.

target_carbon.description: Present after the invitation is bound to a Carbon account; absent before signup and verified email binding.

display_name.description: Defaults to the immutable local Silicon handle when omitted.

SiliconWebhookSubscriptionReplace.description: all receives every explicitly Silicon-routed organization event, including Full-only metadata, catalog, invitation, governance, credential, and configuration events, and canonicalizes the response to all three topic values. selected requires at least one exact topic: membership_lifecycle is actual creation/reactivation/removal, member_updates is applied existing-member role/tag/profile/hierarchy/authorization/ownership change, and trust_updates is trust state only. Optional tag_filter always includes the Silicon's own event-time before/after tag audience and may add active organization tags; later own-tag changes never alter an older event's audience.

tag_filter.description: Null disables tag filtering. When present, organization-wide and unattributed events are suppressed; affected tags must intersect either the Silicon's immutable event-time own-tag audience or a currently configured additional tag.

created_by_membership_id.description: Membership that created the environment; it keeps administrative authority while active.

last_activity_at.description: Last accepted request in the environment; idleness beyond the configured window auto-deletes it.

purge_after.description: Deadline after which the environment and its data are destroyed permanently. Restorable until then.

TestingEnvironmentKeyValue.description: Root authority for one environment. Anyone holding it can do anything inside that environment.

TestingEnvironmentSelf.description: What a key holder may see about the environment it holds a key to.

app_id.description: Canonical production Application id to copy.

app_secret.description: Fresh credential valid only inside this testing environment.

webhook_secret_inherited.description: Confirms that the production signing secret was inherited but not disclosed.

approval_request_id.description: Null for an owner/admin direct change.
Null for an owner/admin direct change.

ApplicationCreate.description: Requires the authenticated Carbon to be a current active owner/admin of org_id.

base_url.description: Pathless Application backend origin with no trailing slash, credentials, query or fragment. HTTPS is required except for literal loopback HTTP in local development.
Pathless backend origin without a trailing slash; HTTPS except for literal loopback development.

obo_endpoints.description: Full replacement. An empty array retires every active endpoint.

Application.description: Organization-owned Application. created_by is immutable provenance and does not confer management authority.

base_url.description: Pathless backend origin without a trailing slash.

AppAccessKeyIssue.description: Issue an application identity key; send an empty object for the default five-minute lifetime.

ttl_seconds.description: Requested lifetime in seconds, from one to sixty minutes inclusive; out-of-range values are rejected.

AppAccessKeyIssued.description: Application identity key returned only at issuance. Keep this credential private and never log it.

app_access_key.description: Opaque random 256-bit application identity key. IAM stores only its hash.

valid_till.description: Absolute UTC expiry in RFC 3339 format.

AppAccessKeyVerify.description: Calling application identity and key. Authenticate the receiving application separately using HTTP Basic.

app_id.description: The calling application's claimed canonical app_id; a mismatch returns valid_key:false.

app_access_key.description: The calling application's identity key; unknown or malformed key values return valid_key:false.

AppAccessKeyVerification.description: Valid keys return app_id and valid_till from the stored record. Invalid keys return only valid_key:false.

valid_till.description: Stored expiry, present only when valid_key is true.

base_url.description: Pathless backend origin without a trailing slash.

application_id.description: Canonical Application ID for binding webhook-approval step-up. Returned on webhook configuration reads and mutations.

active_url.description: Null until the application's initial destination is approved; a verified application's pending endpoint may be approved by its current organization owner/admin or an IAM platform reviewer.

webhook_signing_secret.description: Echoes a caller-supplied replacement secret for v1 compatibility.

secret_replay_expires_at.description: Present exactly when webhook_signing_secret is present.

version.description: Application aggregate version; identical to the response ETag and the value required by If-Match for replacement or approval.

ApplicationWebhookReplace.description: Replaces only the reviewed destination candidate. It normally reuses the existing encrypted signing secret in production. Testing URL replacements install a supplied test-only secret or generate one when omitted and return webhook_signing_secret with its replay expiry. Supplying a secret for any replacement installs it for the new endpoint.

ApplicationWebhookSecret.description: Caller-chosen Application webhook signing secret containing only non-whitespace ASCII characters. IAM encrypts it at rest. Testing webhook URL replacement may generate a fresh secret when one is not supplied.

event_type.description: Stable dotted event name with its positive schema version suffix.

data.description: Event-type-specific authorized projection. Application delivery requires effective declared app scopes, user consent, selected active memberships, and matching webhook event categories. Application recipient unions, payloads, changed_fields, and resource versions are captured in the domain transaction; workers do not hydrate historical events from later state. self.profile.read exposes only display_name, profile_photo, and timezone; identity, contacts, membership status, and other data have separate scopes. self.organizations.read exposes organization identifiers, name, logo, description, and resource version, never SSO or administrative/security configuration. Member events use current.members; organization updates use current.organization. Captured invitation, governance, and tag-creation snapshots use current.resource and require organization.invitations.read, organization.governance.read, and organization.tags.read, respectively. Tag/trust changes may include current.resource plus current.members. Raw trust configuration requires organization.trust.read. self.trust.read exposes only membership.effective_trust from the user's perspective, with target_silicon_membership_id, trust, and no raw defaults, rules, overrides, or rule identifiers. Before-only recipients receive stable resource/version authorization tombstones, not removed private fields. Application payloads never include credentials or raw provider records, SSO events, or Silicon credential-management and webhook/subscription configuration. A completed Silicon credential rotation may expose only its permitted authorization-epoch and access projection. Silicon subscriptions retain their separate event vocabulary. Applications receive carbon.updated.v1 with scope-filtered fields; organization.membership.profile_updated.v1 is the organization-bound Silicon notification of that profile mutation, not a second Application event.

TestingWebhookEvent.description: Explicit test-plane envelope. The signature covers these exact outer bytes. testing_key is the environment root credential and must never be logged or persisted with the event.

SiliconFullEventType.description: Exact closed 38-event vocabulary delivered by Silicon mode=all subscriptions.

ApplicationAdminDecision.description: Platform transition for an application that is already in use. Applications arrive verified, so this suspends, reactivates, rejects or deletes one rather than admitting it. delete is terminal, requires all application administration capabilities plus verified-channel step-up, and accepts reason only; approved_scopes is rejected.

ApplicationOboEndpoint.description: Callable endpoint definition configurable only by a current owner/admin of the Application's organization.

ttl_seconds.description: Provider-configured proof lifetime in seconds; fixed at issuance.

critical.description: Whether calling this endpoint requires approval from the audience application.

endpoint_id.description: Stable identifier; an existing identifier cannot be assigned a different path.

metadata.description: Each top-level key is required at exchange. A descriptor may declare type as string, number, integer, boolean, object, array, or null; size, nesting, and node count are bounded.

OboRequestMethod.description: Canonical uppercase HTTP method included byte-for-byte in the OBO HMAC and proof binding.

OboBodySha256.description: Lowercase hexadecimal SHA-256 digest of the exact downstream request body bytes.

path.description: Exact registered path of the downstream request.

OboExchangeRequest.description: Delegates as the same user to any declared and consented audience; org_id selects a user-authorized organization when more than one is available.

subject_token.description: Actor-bound application access token issued to the calling app.

metadata.description: Exact metadata bound into the proof. It must contain every registered key, no unregistered keys, and values matching every declared type.

OboProofResponse.description: The idempotency replay envelope for this secret response expires no later than expires_at.

OboVerifyRequest.description: Exact actual-request binding; successful verification is strictly single-use and not idempotently replayable.

iam.description: IAM permissions from GET /api/v1/application-scopes; defaults to self.identity.read and self.profile.read on creation. Mutation permissions require approval

reason.description: Required and nonempty when denying a request.

iam_test_key.description: Existing IAM testing key; absent creates a new environment

can_manage.description: True only for the application that created this environment.

is_own.description: Whether the current authenticated Carbon authored this message. System instructions are always false.

critical.description: Null if the scope is no longer published.

in_review.description: Whether this scope is part of the immutable request decision.

current_scope_context.description: The caller's current declared scopes for this reviewing provider only, including non-critical scopes. This is not a submission snapshot and does not change the request decision boundary.

available.description: Whether the authenticated Carbon can configure application bundles in the selected organization.

app_logo.description: HTTPS logo URL. Omit to preserve the current logo; send null to remove it.

app_secret.description: Audience test credential forwarded only for this isolated downstream request.

ApplicationMutationObject.description: Scope-projected response for an ordinary application mutation. Write scopes do not imply read access. Without the corresponding read scopes, existing profile, role, tag, contact, trust, and governance fields are omitted; the response may be an empty object. Applicable identifiers, org_id, membership_id, version, status, and kind may remain as operation receipts. Independently approved read scopes add only their authorized fields, with the same projections as application reads. Silicon creation returns its nested silicon receipt and the explicitly requested one-time silicon_token plus secret_replay_expires_at. Completed credential rotation retains its separate full one-time credential response. Missing fields mean undisclosed, not null/default values. Direct IAM callers receive the full resource schema.

ApplicationReadObject.description: Scope-filtered application bearer response. Fields absent from approved user scopes are omitted. An omitted field is undisclosed and grants no authority.

testing_key.description: Shared root key supplied by Honeycomb for new prepare or rotate-key; requires key_version.

key_version.description: Desired key version; 1 at creation and exactly previous plus 1 on rotation.

expected_key_version.description: Current key version guard; mandatory when authorizing with an environment root key.

app_ids.description: Exact pending apps to activate in an already active environment.

refresh_app_ids.description: Explicit dependency pins to refresh; all other accepted pins remain unchanged.

app_secret.description: One-time secret. Replayable for ten minutes; absent from reconciliation.

key.description: Protected test root key, returned only by preparation and rotation.

configuration_revision.description: Current accepted IAM test configuration revision for rotation (zero for an unchanged import); configuration writes require a positive increasing revision.

HoneycombRecord.description: Accepted IAM state or durable operation status. Never contains credentials or actor tokens.
